summary: Mweka territory (Kasaï) comprises the Mweka, Kakenge, Bulape and Mushenge areas, including the heartland of the Kuba kingdom (royal capital Mushenge/Nsheng). It saw limited spill-over of the Kamuina Nsapu insurgency in 2017, but militias were defeated or demobilised by 2018-2019 and no armed group is known to hold territory as of 2026. Mweka town is policed by the PNC with FARDC and ANR present; rural areas fall under PNC posts and customary chiefs. The Bulape Ebola outbreak (Sept-Dec 2025) was a health rather than security crisis. Live web research was unavailable in this run, so assessments rest on background knowledge and default state presence with limited confidence.

zones.description: Mweka town (territory seat, railway station on the SNCC Ilebo-Kananga line) and its neighbourhoods (Mweka 1-3, Pilote, Congo, Ikit)
zones.evidence: Territorial administrative centre with territorial administrator, PNC commissariat, ANR and a small FARDC presence. The Kamuina Nsapu insurgency touched Mweka territory in 2017 but militias were dispersed by 2018 and no armed group is known to hold the town since. zones.evidence: Former peripheral theatre of the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu crisis (Luba-inhabited southern/eastern areas near Dimbelenge/Demba); militias demobilised or dispersed by 2018-2019 and no armed-group territorial control reported since. Order relies on PNC posts, customary chiefs and occasional FARDC deployments. Not verified with fresh sources in this run (web search budget exhausted, news/UN sites blocked by egress proxy).

zones.description: Bulape and Mushenge secteurs (Kuba kingdom heartland, incl. Mushenge/Nsheng royal capital, Bulape, Bulongo Bakuba, Popo, Tshitekeshi)
zones.evidence: Kuba (Bakuba) area where the Nyimi's customary authority coexists with PNC posts; no armed-group activity known. Bulape health zone was the epicentre of the Ebola outbreak of Sept-Dec 2025, which was handled by the state health response with police escorts, without armed-group interference reported.
